translations.literal: Treatise Thirty-Nine.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 39

translations.literal: Geography Eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Geography 11

translations.literal: Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu

sentences.zh: 甘肅：禹貢雍州南兼梁州。

translations.literal: Gansu: In the Yugong, southern Yong and also Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu: in the Tribute of Yu, the southern part of Yong Province and also Liang Province.

translations.literal: The domain thereof.
translations.idiomatic: That territory.

sentences.zh: 明陝西布政使司及陝西行都指揮使司地。

translations.literal: Ming territory of Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commission and Shaanxi Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it comprised the territory of the Shaanxi provincial administration commission and the Shaanxi regional military commission.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，因明制，設甘肅巡撫，駐寧夏。

translations.literal: Early Shunzhi of Qing, following Ming system, established Gansu governor-general, garrisoned at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shunzhi reign the Qing followed the Ming system and established a Gansu governor-general, stationed at Ningxia.

translations.literal: Ningxia governor-general soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ningxia post was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 五年，徙甘肅巡撫駐蘭州。

translations.literal: Year five, moved Gansu governor-general to garrison at Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Gansu governor-general was moved to Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，分陝西為左、右布政使司，以右布政使司駐鞏昌，領四府如故。

translations.literal: Kangxi year three, divided Shaanxi into left and right provincial administration commissions; the right commission was at Gongchang, governing four prefectures as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi, Shaanxi was divided into eastern and western provincial administration commissions; the western commission was stationed at Gongchang and continued to govern the same four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六年，改陝西右布政使司為鞏昌布政使司。

translations.literal: Year six, changed Shaanxi right commission to Gongchang commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the western Shaanxi commission was renamed the Gongchang provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 七年，又改甘肅布政使司，徙治蘭州。

translations.literal: Year seven, again changed to Gansu commission, moved seat to Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year it was renamed again the Gansu provincial administration commission and the seat was moved to Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，裁行都指揮使司及諸衛所，改置甘州、涼州、寧夏、西寧，升肅州及秦、階二州為直隸州。

translations.literal: Yongzheng year three, abolished regional military commission and guard posts, established Ganzhou, Liangzhou, Ningxia, Xining; promoted Suzhou and Qin and Jie two prefectures to directly controlled prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongzheng the regional military commission and all guard posts were abolished; Ganzhou, Liangzhou, Ningxia, and Xining were created; and Suzhou together with Qin and Jie prefectures were elevated to directly controlled prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，廢臨洮府徙蘭州，因更名。

translations.literal: Qianlong year three, abolished Lintao prefecture and moved seat to Lanzhou, therefore renamed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianlong, Lintao prefecture was abolished and its seat moved to Lanzhou, and the prefecture was renamed accordingly.

translations.literal: Year twenty-four, established Anxi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Anxi prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，裁巡撫，以陝甘總督治蘭州，行巡撫事。

translations.literal: Year twenty-nine, abolished governor-general; Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general at Lanzhou performed governor duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the governorship was abolished, and the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general at Lanzhou assumed its functions.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，置鎮西府於巴里坤、迪化直隸州於烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: Year thirty-eight, established Zhenxi prefecture at Barkol and Dihua directly controlled prefecture at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year Zhenxi prefecture was established at Barkol and Dihua directly controlled prefecture at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，降安西府為直隸州。

translations.literal: Year thirty-nine, reduced Anxi prefecture to directly controlled prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year Anxi prefecture was downgraded to a directly controlled prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，升涇州為直隸州。

translations.literal: Year forty-two, promoted Jingzhou to directly controlled prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year Jingzhou was elevated to a directly controlled prefecture.

sentences.zh: 同治十一年，置化平川直隸廳。

translations.literal: Tongzhi year eleven, established Huapingchuan directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, Huapingchuan directly controlled subprefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 十二年，升固原州為直隸州。

translations.literal: Year twelve, promoted Guyuanzhou to directly controlled prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Guyuan was elevated to a directly controlled prefecture.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年，新疆改建行省，割迪化、鎮西往屬。

translations.literal: Guangxu year twelve, Xinjiang reorganized as province, ceded Dihua and Zhenxi away.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Guangxu, when Xinjiang was reorganized as a province, Dihua and Zhenxi were detached and placed under it.

translations.literal: East to Shaanxi;
translations.idiomatic: On the east it borders Shaanxi,

translations.literal: And Fuzhou, Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: reaching Fuzhou and Binzhou.

translations.literal: South to Sichuan;
translations.idiomatic: On the south it borders Sichuan,

translations.literal: Baoning, Long'an.
translations.idiomatic: at Baoning and Long'an.

translations.literal: Southwest to Qinghai;
translations.idiomatic: On the southwest it borders Qinghai;

sentences.zh: 北至阿拉善、額濟納二旗。

translations.literal: North to Alashan and Ejina two banners.
translations.idiomatic: on the north, the Alashan and Ejina banners;

sentences.zh: 及喀爾喀札薩克圖汗部。

translations.literal: And Khalkha Zasagtu Khan division.
translations.idiomatic: and the Khalkha Zasagtu Khanate of Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 廣二千一百二十里，袤一千四百十里。

translations.literal: Width two thousand one hundred twenty li, length one thousand four hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It measures 2,120 li from east to west and 1,410 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，編戶九十萬六千六百三十九，口四百六十九萬一千六百二十。

translations.literal: Xuantong year three, registered households nine hundred six thousand six hundred thirty-nine, population four million six hundred ninety-one thousand six hundred twenty.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong there were 906,639 registered households and a population of 4,691,620.

sentences.zh: 領府八，直隸州六，直隸廳一，州六，廳八，縣四十七。

translations.literal: Governing eight prefectures, six directly controlled prefectures, one directly controlled subprefecture, six prefectures, eight subprefectures, forty-seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised eight prefectures, six directly controlled prefectures, one directly controlled subprefecture, six dependent prefectures, eight subprefectures, and forty-seven counties.

sentences.zh: 其名山：隴、嶓冢、崆峒、西傾、積石。

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: Long, Boshong, Kongtong, Xiqing, Jishi.
translations.idiomatic: Its notable mountains include Long, Boshong, Kongtong, Xiqing, and Jishi.

sentences.zh: 其大川：黃河、西漢、渭、涇、洮、湟。

translations.literal: Its great rivers: Yellow River, Xihan, Wei, Jing, Tao, Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Its major rivers are the Yellow River, Xihan, Wei, Jing, Tao, and Huangshui.

translations.literal: Its important passes: Xiaoguan, Jiayu, Yumen.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief strategic passes are Xiaoguan, Jiayuguan, and Yumenguan.

sentences.zh: 其驛道：一，東南逾六盤達陝西長武；

translations.literal: Its courier routes: one, southeast over Liupan reaching Shaanxi Changwu;
translations.idiomatic: Its post roads: one runs southeast over Liupan to Changwu in Shaanxi;

sentences.zh: 一，西北渡河出嘉峪關達新疆哈密。

translations.literal: One, northwest crossing river exiting Jiayuguan reaching Xinjiang Hami.
translations.idiomatic: another runs northwest across the river, out through Jiayuguan to Hami in Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 電線：西北通迪化，東南通西安。

translations.literal: Telegraph lines: northwest connecting Dihua, southeast connecting Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Telegraph lines: northwest to Dihua, southeast to Xi'an.

translations.literal: Lanzhou Prefecture: strategically important, busy, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Lanzhou Prefecture: strategically important, busy, and difficult to administer.

sentences.zh: 陝甘總督，布政、提學、提法三使，巡警、勸業道駐。

translations.literal: Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, provincial administration, education, and judicial commissioners, police and industry intendants stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, the provincial administration, education, and judicial commissioners, and the police and industry intendants.

sentences.zh: 明為州，屬臨洮府，領金、渭源、河州。

translations.literal: Ming as prefecture, subordinate to Lintao prefecture, governing Jin, Weiyuan, Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was a prefecture subordinate to Lintao and governed Jin, Weiyuan, and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，徙臨洮府來治，更名，以所隸河州、狄道、渭源三州縣改屬，升狄道為州，置皋蘭縣為府治，兼割鞏昌府屬之靖遠隸之。

translations.literal: Qianlong year three, moved Lintao prefecture seat here, renamed; the subordinate Hezhou, Didao, Weiyuan three prefectures and counties were reassigned, promoted Didao to prefecture, established Gaolan County as prefectural seat, and also detached Jingyuan from Gongchang prefecture to place under it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianlong the Lintao prefectural seat was moved here and the prefecture renamed; Hezhou, Didao, and Weiyuan were reassigned under it, Didao was elevated to a prefecture, Gaolan County was established as the prefectural seat, and Jingyuan was detached from Gongchang prefecture and placed under Lanzhou as well.

sentences.zh: 東北距京師四千四十里。

translations.literal: Northeast from capital four thousand forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 4,040 li northeast of the capital.

sentences.zh: 廣千二百二十五里，袤八百里。

translations.literal: Width one thousand two hundred twenty-five li, length eight hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It measures 1,225 li from east to west and 800 li from north to south.

translations.literal: North polar altitude thirty-six degrees eight minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 36°8′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西四十二度三十四分。

translations.literal: Capital meridian west by forty-two degrees thirty-four minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 42°34′ west of the capital meridian.

translations.literal: Governing two prefectures, four counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised two prefectures and four counties.

translations.literal: Gaolan: strategically important, busy, taxing, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Gaolan County: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Attached.
translations.idiomatic: Attached to the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 城南五里，皋蘭山，五泉出其下。

translations.literal: Five li south of city, Gaolan Mountain; Five Springs issue from below it.
translations.idiomatic: Five li south of the city is Gaolan Mountain, from whose foot the Five Springs issue.

translations.literal: One hundred forty li, Kanglang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred forty li away is Kanglang Mountain.

translations.literal: North: Jiuzhou, Taishan, Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Jiuzhou, Taishan, and Songshan.

translations.literal: West: Wogan Ridge, Maxian Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Wogan Ridge and Maxian Mountain.

sentences.zh: 黃河，西南自河州入，西流，至孔家寺，折而東北，復東流，迤南，逕城北，至東坪，與金縣分界。

translations.literal: Yellow River, entering from southwest from Hezhou, flows west; at Kongjia Temple turns northeast, again flows east, winds south, passes north of city wall, to Dongping, borders with Jin County.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River enters from the southwest out of Hezhou and flows west; at Kongjia Temple it turns northeast, then flows east again, winding south past the north of the city wall to Dongping, where it forms the boundary with Jin County.

sentences.zh: 又東北，逕烏金峽，入靖遠。

translations.literal: Again northeast, passes Wujin Gorge, enters Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It continues northeast through Wujin Gorge and enters Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 洮水南自狄道入，西北流，至毛龍峽入黃河。

translations.literal: Tao River enters from south from Didao, flows northwest, at Maolong Gorge enters Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Tao River enters from the south out of Didao, flows northwest, and at Maolong Gorge joins the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 邊牆，西自平番來，起縣西北毛牛圈，東南迤至小蘆塘，入靖遠鹽池。

translations.literal: Border wall, from west coming from Pingfan, begins northwest of county at Maoniujuan, winds southeast to Xiaolutang, enters Jingyuan salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: The border wall comes from Pingfan in the west, begins at Maoniujuan northwest of the county, runs southeast to Xiaolutang, and enters the Jingyuan salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 邊牆外，北與蒙古分界，有界碑六。

translations.literal: Outside border wall, north borders Mongolia, has six boundary steles.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the border wall, to the north the boundary with Mongolia is marked by six boundary steles.

translations.literal: One garrison: Nami.
translations.idiomatic: One garrison: Nami.

translations.literal: Three courier stations: Lanquan, Shajing, Moyun.
translations.idiomatic: Three courier stations: Lanquan, Shajing, and Moyun.

translations.literal: Assistant magistrate garrisoned at Hongshuibao.
translations.idiomatic: An assistant magistrate was stationed at Hongshuibao.

translations.literal: Jin: strategically important, taxing.
translations.idiomatic: Jin County: strategically important and taxing.

translations.literal: Prefecture southeast eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies eighty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: South: Kan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Kan Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest: Maxian Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Maxian Mountain.

translations.literal: Northeast: Beiluan Mountain, Chedao Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast: Beiluan Mountain and Chedao Ridge.

translations.literal: East: Tuoxiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Tuoxiang.

translations.literal: Northwest: Zhuzui.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest: Zhuzui.

sentences.zh: 黃河自皋蘭入，南新營河自狄道入，至大營川，右合瓦家河，左合清水河，合龕峪、徐家峽、大峽諸水，西北至皋蘭入於河。

translations.literal: Yellow River enters from Gaolan; Nanxinying River enters from Didao; at Dayingchuan, right joins Wajia River, left joins Qingshui River, joins Kan Valley, Xujia Gorge, Daxia and other waters, northwest to Gaolan enters river.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River enters from Gaolan; the Nanxinying River enters from Didao; at Dayingchuan the Wajia River joins from the right and the Qingshui River from the left; the Kan Valley, Xujia Gorge, Daxia, and other streams unite, and the waters flow northwest to Gaolan and enter the river.

sentences.zh: 黃河又東北過烏金峽入靖遠。

translations.literal: Yellow River again northeast passes Wujin Gorge enters Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River continues northeast through Wujin Gorge into Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 邊牆，西自皋蘭來，逾黃河南至索橋，合舊邊牆，東北入中衛。

translations.literal: Border wall, from west coming from Gaolan, crosses Yellow River south to Suoqiao, joins old border wall, northeast enters Zhongwei.
translations.idiomatic: The border wall comes from Gaolan in the west, crosses south of the Yellow River to Suoqiao, joins the old border wall, and runs northeast into Zhongwei.

translations.literal: Two courier stations: Dingyuan, Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: Two courier stations: Dingyuan and Qingshui.

translations.literal: Didao Prefecture: busy, taxing, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Didao Prefecture: busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Prefecture south two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred li south of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: South: Mobang Mountain, Mei Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Mobang Mountain and Mei Mountain.

translations.literal: North: Maxian Mountain, former Guanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Maxian Mountain and the former Guanyuan plateau.

translations.literal: West: Xiping Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Xiping Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest: Eighteen Turns Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Eighteen Turns Mountain.

sentences.zh: 洮水，南自洮州入，合抹邦、東峪、三岔、留川四水及諸小水，屈曲北注，逕沙泥州判境，沙泥水出摩雲嶺西麓，西流入之。

translations.literal: Tao River, enters from south from Taozhou, joins Mobang, Dongyu, Sancha, Liuchuan four rivers and various small waters, winding flows north, passes Shani subprefectural judge's territory; Shani River issues from west foot of Moyun Ridge, flows west into it.
translations.idiomatic: The Tao River enters from the south out of Taozhou, receives the Mobang, Dongyu, Sancha, and Liuchuan rivers and various smaller streams, and winds northward through the territory of the Shani subprefectural judge; the Shani River rises on the western slope of Moyun Ridge and flows west to join it.

translations.literal: Tao River again north, enters Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: The Tao River continues north into Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 州北河渠，雍正三年濬，引洮流溉田三百頃。

translations.literal: North of prefecture river canal, Yongzheng year three dredged, drew Tao flow to irrigate three hundred qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: A canal north of the prefecture was dredged in the third year of Yongzheng to draw Tao River water and irrigate three hundred qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 趙土司駐所，州東南六盤山麓。

translations.literal: Zhao native official's garrison, southeast of prefecture at foot of Liupan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhao native official's headquarters lay at the foot of Liupan Mountain southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 驛四：沙泥、洮陽、窯店、慶平。

translations.literal: Four courier stations: Shani, Taoyang, Yaodian, Qingping.
translations.idiomatic: Four courier stations: Shani, Taoyang, Yaodian, and Qingping.

translations.literal: Prefectural judge garrisoned at Shanibao.
translations.idiomatic: A subprefectural judge was stationed at Shanibao.

translations.literal: Weiyuan: strategically important, taxing.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyuan County: strategically important and taxing.

translations.literal: Prefecture south slightly east two hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred fifty li south and slightly east of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Northwest: Seven Peaks Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest: Seven Peaks Mountain.

translations.literal: South: Lugu.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Lugu.

translations.literal: Southwest: Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 西：鳥鼠山，渭水出其北麓，東南流，逕城北，合清源、鍬峪兩水，東入隴西。

translations.literal: West: Bird-and-Rat Mountain; Wei River issues from its north foot, flows southeast, passes north of city wall, joins Qingyuan and Qiaoyu two rivers, east enters Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Bird-and-Rat Mountain; the Wei River rises on its northern slope, flows southeast past the north of the city wall, joins the Qingyuan and Qiaoyu rivers, and flows east into Longxi.

translations.literal: One courier station: Qingping.
translations.idiomatic: One courier station: Qingping.

translations.literal: Jingyuan: taxing, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan County: taxing and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Prefecture northeast two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Ming, Jinglu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was Jinglu Guard.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年省衛，設同知，屬鞏昌。

translations.literal: Yongzheng year two abolished guard, established subprefect, subordinate to Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng the guard was abolished and a subprefect was established under Gongchang.

translations.literal: Year eight established county, abolished subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year a county was established and the subprefect was abolished.

translations.literal: Qianlong year three came under jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qianlong it was placed under Lanzhou.

translations.literal: East: Hongshan, Quwu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Hongshan and Quwu Mountain.

translations.literal: South: Wulan.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Wulan.

translations.literal: North: Snow Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Snow Mountain.

sentences.zh: 黃河，西南自金縣入，至城北，祖厲河南自會寧來，會左關川水，北流入之。

translations.literal: Yellow River, enters from southwest from Jin County, to north of city wall; Zulie River south from Huining comes, joins Zuoguan River water, flows north into it.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River enters from the southwest out of Jin County and reaches the north of the city wall; the Zulie River comes from Huining in the south, joins the Zuoguan River, and flows north to enter it.

sentences.zh: 黃河又納縣境諸水，北流，迤西逾邊牆，東北入中衛。

translations.literal: Yellow River again receives various waters within county, flows north, winds west crossing border wall, northeast enters Zhongwei.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River then receives the various streams within the county, flows north, winds west across the border wall, and runs northeast into Zhongwei.

sentences.zh: 邊牆，自皋蘭紅水堡來，接中衛。

translations.literal: Border wall, from Gaolan Hongshuibao comes, connects to Zhongwei.
translations.idiomatic: The border wall comes from Hongshuibao in Gaolan and connects with Zhongwei.

translations.literal: Hezhou: busy, taxing, difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhou Prefecture: busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Prefecture southwest two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 陝西河州鎮總兵駐，雍正四年，省河水衛併入州屬。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Hezhou garrison commander-general stationed; Yongzheng year four, abolished Heshui Guard and merged into prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Hezhou garrison commander-general was stationed here; in the fourth year of Yongzheng the Heshui Guard was abolished and merged into the prefecture.

translations.literal: North: Fenglin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Fenglin Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest: Shimen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Shimen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西北：小積石山，即水經注唐述山。

translations.literal: Northwest: Little Jishi Mountain, that is the Tangshu Mountain in the Water Classic Commentary.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest: Little Jishi Mountain, identified in the Water Classic Commentary as Tangshu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 黃河，西自循化入，至積石關入州境，右納樣卑、吹麻、銀川三水，東逕城南，又東至蓮花寺。

translations.idiomatic: Exiting the border wall, it is diverted to the right as the Shuangshuzi garrison canal and to the left as the Maomu canal; the White River joins it from the prefecture in the southwest; flowing north into the territory of the Ejin Banner, it converges at Juyan Sea.
